description: Source code for the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients, including creation, control, and release of media player instances, utilizing GStreamer objects and threading synchronization.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing media player clients, including attaching, detaching, and controlling media playback instances.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a media player client, including the client object, controller, and reference count.

methods.name: MediaPlayerManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the current GStreamer bin parent to nullptr.

methods.name: ~MediaPlayerManager
methods.description: Destructor that releases the media player client.

methods.name: attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a specified GStreamer bin parent, creating a new client if necessary.

methods.name: getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the current instance has control over the media player client.

methods.name: releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client, decreasing reference count and cleaning up if needed.

methods.name: acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control of a media player client if no controller exists.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new media player client for a given GStreamer bin parent.
